title: Cell-Cycle Checkpoints and Control Mechanisms
method: Whitespace-delimited visible article text, narrative excludes headings, tables, figures, practice and references. Total includes captions, headings, practice and references, excluding SVG and zoom buttons.
comparator: 2.D.02: 8495 narrative words, 18 sections. 2.C.10: 8610 narrative words. This narrower checkpoint-specific node provides 13 substantive theory sections, including two extended experimental/quantitative sections and scope-bound distinctions; no fixed quota.
scientific_checks: Merged NET Unit 2.D p.3, separate NET Unit 2.D p.2 and archived MP SET 2024 p.2 visually verified. Textbook Alberts; Pardee restriction point, yeast RAD9 experiments, ATR/ATM/Chk, Rieder kinetochore evidence and MCC review checked. First draft expanded with marker interpretation, experimental controls, fiber reading, seven worked numerical cases, species and outcome limits; corrected sister-chromatid schematic and invalid paragraph nesting. Second source review checked causal direction, arithmetic, checkpoint/repair distinction, Rb/p53 context, CDK1 inhibitory phosphorylation, SAC vs attachment correction and exam distractors. All practice and synthetic datasets original.
limitations: Two editorial passes by same assistant, not independent human review. Static source checks, not browser/device rendering or interactive accessibility tests. Current original MPPSC-hosted SET syllabus unavailable; archived SET 2024 used. Both immediate neighbors were published on the latest baseline and reciprocal navigation was linked. Live Pages verification separate and pending.
